Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The module comment now agrees with issue #1854 and the decision for #1715. It states that each band starts its own level ladder, levels can move by less than one stepdown, and links between bands are not generated or verified. The decision file records the reason and the options that were not used.

Local checks against upstream/main at 31f8d03d744e77ce707282d816e11efe0922f239:

- The trial merge was clean. The PR already contains this main commit.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run` passed. It selected the finish-band suite.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run` passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test shared_face_bodies_finish` passed: 1 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

Requested changes: none.

Only prose changed. Posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, and gouge and collision checks did not change. No goldens moved. Safety mutation checks do not apply. The six heavy tests and the release gate were not run. No UI files changed, so before and after screenshots do not apply.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
